The research centers on document analysis and structured representation to support compliance and risk minimization.

about_short_description.short_description: Icertis is an AI-powered contract management platform that ensures compliance and minimizes risk.

product.name: Icertis Platform
product.description: An enterprise contract intelligence platform that centralizes contracts, converts agreement data into structured information, and connects contracting workflows with business systems.

product.name: Icertis Contract Management
product.description: Contract lifecycle management software for creating, negotiating, executing, storing, and monitoring agreements, obligations, compliance, and performance.

product.name: Icertis Copilot
product.description: An AI-powered contract assistant that helps users find agreements, summarize documents, extract contract insights, and automate contract-related workflows.

product.name: Icertis Engage
product.description: A contract engagement capability for AI-assisted drafting, redlining, negotiation, and execution of business agreements.

product.name: Icertis Analyze
product.description: Contract analytics software that provides portfolio-wide visibility into contract terms, obligations, risks, compliance, and business performance.

product.name: Icertis Integrations
product.description: Connectivity capabilities that embed contract creation, review, approval, and collaboration into enterprise business applications and workflows.
